title: 第10章 消失万年的天使武魂重现？特招入史莱克
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

霍雨浩受之前唐雅的科普，已然知道了史莱克学院，他又隐隐察觉老师对这些不懂，所以指着远处那栋最宏伟的建筑，给千仞雪科普。

果然一下子便吸引了老师的注意。

“这便是所谓的大陆第一学院——史莱克吗？很好。”

千仞雪不再废话，一把拉过霍雨浩，提着他的衣领，然后带着他整个人如箭矢一般朝前疾驰，速度很快，没一会两人便看到了史莱克学院恢弘的大门。

“来者何人？！”

正在欣赏史莱克学院的师徒俩被突然响起声音叫住，转眼一看是一个中年男子，身穿史莱克教师制服，千仞雪观其气息，是64级魂帝。

看来是史莱克学院的人了。

千仞雪打量后得出结论，但千仞雪还没有亮明身份，反倒是史莱克学院这边人先动了。

只见不光刚才问话之人，还一连走出两位史莱克老师，他们神情虽然还有刚见面的倨傲，但不知是不是发现了千仞雪的实力，他们神情中的倨傲少了，更多的是郑重。

“阁下来我史莱克有何贵干？我观阁下气质不凡，不像只是送学的家长。”

千仞雪笑了，能见到史莱克学院对自己这样警戒，倒也让她愉悦，那计划也就成功了一半。

想到这，千仞雪气息变得温和，看向问话之人。

“我名千仞雪，93级强攻系封号斗罗，封号天使，这是我的徒弟，霍雨浩。来此并无什么别的目的，只是我徒儿仰慕史莱克学院许久，而我也刚还没什么去处，所以携弟子前来应聘史莱克学院，不知贵校可欢迎？”

“封号斗罗？！”

千仞雪的话让史莱克学院几位招生处的老师震惊，尤其是刚才问千仞雪的那位，他是这批招生老师中实力最强的，有72级，所以几人在听到千仞雪自报家门后，其他三位不约而同地看向他。

而他也知道同事的意思：他为何这么紧张眼前女子？

就是她的气息跟其他家长不一样，那是一种让他忐忑的气息，所以即使无法得知她的具体魂力，他也知道那是远高于他的存在。

所以李锋对着几位悄悄点了点头，几人了然，随后——

“前辈，当然可以。我史莱克学院欢迎所有有能之士加入，不过千前辈，您的实力不是我等能够应聘的，需要向上禀报，由外院院长亲自定夺。不知能否跟我等去见见言院长？”

“好，不过我徒弟能否跟我一起？”

“哦，当然没问题，不过我还是建议您徒弟先去我史莱克学院招生处报名为好。今天是我史莱克学院报名截止日期，错过了可不好。”

“嗯，那雨浩，你先去报名，我这边解决了就去找你。”

“好的，老师。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Huo Yuhao already knew about Shrek Academy through Tang Ya's previous science education. He also vaguely realized that the teacher didn't understand these things, so he pointed to the most magnificent building in the distance to teach Qian Renxue.

Sure enough, it immediately attracted the teacher's attention.

"Is this the so-called No. 1 Academy in the Mainland - Shrek? Very good."

Qian Renxue stopped talking nonsense, grabbed Huo Yuhao, held his collar, and then led him forward like an arrow. The speed was very fast. After a while, the two of them saw the grand gate of Shrek Academy.

"Who is coming?!"

The two masters and apprentices who were admiring Shrek Academy were stopped by a sudden voice. In a blink of an eye, they saw a middle-aged man wearing a Shrek teacher's uniform. Qian Renxue looked at his aura. He was a level 64 soul emperor.

It seems that he is from Shrek Academy.

Qian Renxue came to a conclusion after looking at it, but before Qian Renxue revealed her identity, it was the people from Shrek Academy who made the move first.

Not only the person who had just asked the question, but also two Shrek teachers walked out one after another. Although their expressions were still as arrogant as when they had just met, they may have discovered Qian Renxue's strength. Their expressions were less arrogant and more solemn.

"Why do you want me, Shrek? Your Majesty has an extraordinary temperament. You don't look like a parent who just sends you to school."

Qian Renxue smiled. It made her happy to see Shrek Academy being so wary of her. The plan was half successful.

Thinking of this, Qian Renxue's breath became gentle and she looked at the person who asked the question.

"My name is Qian Renxue, I am a level 93 Titled Douluo of the Attack Department and a Titled Angel. This is my disciple, Huo Yuhao. I have no other purpose in coming here. It's just that my disciple has admired Shrek Academy for a long time, and I haven't had anywhere to go yet, so I brought my disciple here to apply for Shrek Academy. I wonder if your school will welcome you?"

"Title Douluo?!"

Qian Renxue's words shocked several teachers in the admissions office of Shrek Academy, especially the one who asked Qian Renxue just now. He was the strongest among this group of admissions teachers, with a level of 72, so after several people heard Qian Renxue announcing her home, the other three looked at him in unison.

And he also knew what his colleague meant: Why was he so nervous about the woman in front of him?

Her aura was different from other parents, it was an aura that made him uneasy, so even if he couldn't know her specific soul power, he knew that it was an existence far higher than him.

So Li Feng quietly nodded to a few people, and they understood, and then——

"Senior, of course you can. Our Shrek Academy welcomes all capable people to join, but Senior Qian, your strength is not something that we can apply for. You need to report it to the superiors, and the dean of the outer academy will make a personal decision. I wonder if you can follow me to see Dean Yan?"

"Okay, but can my apprentice come with me?"

"Oh, of course there is no problem, but I still suggest that your apprentice go to the admissions office of Shrek Academy to register first. Today is the deadline for registration at Shrek Academy. It would be bad if you miss it."

"Well, then Yuhao, you go and sign up first. I'll go find you after I solve the problem here."

"Okay, teacher."
